   **Баги и стабильность.**
      18 свежих отзыв(ов) упоминают: баги и стабильность.
      Период отзывов: 20 апр. 2026 г. - 24 сент. 2026 г.
      **Что это значит:** Пользователи упоминают краши или нестабильность. Это actionable только при всплеске или после обновления; иначе часто baseline-шум.

         **Примеры отзывов:**
            1. _BlA387532_, 24 сент. 2026 г., 1/5: "The amount of times it glitches is absolutely uncanny. And that for 700€+ per year. Currently looking for an alternative."
            2. _WaasSun_, 24 сент. 2026 г., 1/5: "It just keep pulling everything up. Unusable on Mac."
            3. _.oliviaaa_, 15 авг. 2026 г., 1/5: "There's a lot of issues on mobile compared to the desktop version. For example, when you select a paragraph and try to delete it instead of holding down the delete button, it doesn't delete. Sometimes even when you hold down the delete button, a letter or two doesn't get deleted. It's generally laggy and without a premium subscription, you can't even upload a single video as the file max is 10mb and most videos are over that. You have to find a site and register to embed the videos instead. Overall greedy platform. Used to be good until it became buggy and you're can't upload a video without the app's premium subscription being shoved down your throat."
